svg.aria-label: COMPACT B / RAISED WHOLE HOUSE AND APPROACH COST
svg.text: COMPACT B / RAISED WHOLE HOUSE AND APPROACH COST
D1300 = authored reference design, not available site head
05 / ONE RAISED-PLINTH COMPARATOR, WITH ITS PLOT COST
Principal approach:26000 horizontal at1:20 rises1300; landings/turns are additional.
Grade and path are authored comparison datums, not a surveyed plot or access approval.
Accepted synthetic floor/grade150 → proposed1300: whole-house rise1150.
All storeys, eaves and roof move1150 relative fixed exterior grade; internal stair heights stay.
Actual eaves/ridge heights, street scale, planning limit and neighbouring levels need a real site.
The26m straight route is deliberately expensive; a switchback spends landings, width and view.
Garden doors also need a terrace or actual graded route; no1300 step is silently accepted.
RWT must still calculate assigned rain, operating head and independent event-bound receivers.
The existing−75 crest is only activation geometry; it does not prove operating water below harm.
Decision: develop this one full-depth comparator; no adopted house or site claim.
The constructive section spends depth and plot length honestly; it retains explicit door/material holds.
UNADOPTED COMPACT B / 1 November 2026 / HAD03 incomplete; RWT06 blocked.
Reference design, not released for construction. Primary source and unresolved physical/material/site duties accompany the result.
